question: Who among the following was the Chief Justice of India – designate in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice NV Ramana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Justice **NV Ramana** took the oath as the **48th Chief Justice of India** on 24 April 2021 at Rashtrapati Bhawan.
 
• In March 2021, then** **Chief Justice SA Bobde of the Supreme Court recommended him as his successor.
 
• Nuthalapati Venkata Ramana was born on 27 August 1957 at Ponnavaram, Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• Previously, he was a judge on the Supreme Court of India, chief justice of Delhi High Court and the acting chief justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Justice DY Chandrachud was appointed as the acting chairman of the National Legal Services Authority.
 
• Earlier this post was occupied by Chief Justice of India UU Lalit.
 
• Justice DY Chandrachud, a Supreme Court judge, is a former Chief Justice of the Allahabad High Court and a former judge of the Bombay High Court.
 
• Justice Chandrachud will take over as the** 50th Chief Justice of India in November 2022, succeeding UU Lalit.**
 
• National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
 
 
• The National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) has been constituted under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 to monitor and evaluate the implementation of legal aid programs.
 
• To lay down policies and principles for providing legal services under this Act.
